production.audience: General older audience for fictional suspense; not a children’s channel
narrative_rules: Write original fiction and clearly identify it as fiction in the description.
Build suspense around one specific setting and recurring clue or object.
Escalate through coherent cause and effect; plant the clue before its payoff.
Deliver an understandable unsettling ending, not an unexplained random twist.
Use natural English narration; no historical trivia or claims that invented events actually happened.
Use tension without graphic gore and without promotional calls to action.
visual_rules: Moody but readable illustrations; clear silhouettes and important objects.
Preserve the same location, characters and recurring prop across scenes.
Describe one visible moment per scene; keep the eventual sound design subordinate to narration.
